title: proto.ltc.in~
description: `proto.ltc.in~` decodes an incoming Linear Timecode (LTC) signal, outputting time as an HOUR MINUTE SECOND FRAME list and date as a YEAR MONTH DAY list. Date decoding is enabled by default and can be controlled with `@use_date`; the current frame rate and input signal level are available through the read-only `@fps?` and `@volume?` properties.
